problem_statement:
Fix `subset_hook_caller` getting confused by `specname`

Previously, subset hook callers didn't properly exclude hookimpls which
used `specname`. It incorrectly checked the hookimpl function name
itself, which can be whatever when using `specname`.

[ran: commit message, code tweaks, changelog]
patch:
diff --git a/src/pluggy/_manager.py b/src/pluggy/_manager.py
index b265aecc1767d7c06c9ed1a38c1dcc40a20f1b03..06923c201f40548cea6735f71ee7b39844b049cf 100644
--- a/src/pluggy/_manager.py
+++ b/src/pluggy/_manager.py
@@ -603,14 +603,20 @@ class PluginManager:
     def subset_hook_caller(
         self, name: str, remove_plugins: Iterable[_Plugin]
     ) -> HookCaller:
-        """Return a proxy :class:`~pluggy.HookCaller` instance for the named
-        method which manages calls to all registered plugins except the ones
-        from remove_plugins."""
+        """Return a proxy :class:`~pluggy.HookCaller` for the named hook which
+        calls all registered plugins except the ones from remove_plugins."""
         orig: HookCaller = getattr(self.hook, name)
-        plugins_to_remove = {plug for plug in remove_plugins if hasattr(plug, name)}
-        if plugins_to_remove:
-            return _SubsetHookCaller(orig, plugins_to_remove)
-        return orig
+        plugins_to_remove = set(remove_plugins)
+        # Optimization: discard plugins to remove which don't actually implement
+        # the hook, to make checks faster.
+        plugins_to_remove.intersection_update(
+            hookimpl.plugin for hookimpl in orig._hookimpls
+        )
+        # Optimization: if none of the plugins to remove actually implement the
+        # hook, avoid the subset hook caller overhead.
+        if not plugins_to_remove:
+            return orig
+        return _SubsetHookCaller(orig, plugins_to_remove)
 
 
 def _formatdef(func: Callable[..., object]) -> str:
test_patch:
diff --git a/testing/test_pluginmanager.py b/testing/test_pluginmanager.py
index 43c2f73ac01605bb0452a3a050a6d27e9e984246..c35d686364b162d9b8a88bbd68d9efe45919d1b5 100644
--- a/testing/test_pluginmanager.py
+++ b/testing/test_pluginmanager.py
@@ -708,6 +708,44 @@ def test_subset_hook_caller(pm: PluginManager) -> None:
     assert repr(hc) == "<_SubsetHookCaller 'he_method1'>"
 
 
+def test_subset_hook_caller_with_specname(pm: PluginManager) -> None:
+    """Test that subset_hook_caller doesn't get confused by specname."""
+
+    class Hooks:
+        @hookspec
+        def he_method1(self):
+            pass
+
+        @hookspec
+        def he_method2(self):
+            pass
+
+    pm.add_hookspecs(Hooks)
+
+    class Plugin1:
+        @hookimpl(specname="he_method1")
+        def alias(self):
+            return 1  # pragma: no cover
+
+    class Plugin2:
+        @hookimpl
+        def he_method1(self):
+            return 2
+
+    class Plugin3:
+        @hookimpl(specname="he_method2")
+        def he_method1(self):
+            return 3  # pragma: no cover
+
+    plugin1, plugin2, plugin3 = Plugin1(), Plugin2(), Plugin3()
+    pm.register(plugin1)
+    pm.register(plugin2)
+    pm.register(plugin3)
+
+    hc = pm.subset_hook_caller("he_method1", remove_plugins=[plugin1])
+    assert hc() == [2]
+
+
 def test_get_hookimpls(pm: PluginManager) -> None:
     class Hooks:
         @hookspec

本机 git 全局 core.autocrlf=true ⇒ 构造器的全部 git 调用钉死 -c core.autocrlf=false，否则补丁正文（LF）与工作树（CRLF）不匹配、git apply 失败 ; §9.1 的 git status --porcelain 为空判据不含被仓库 .gitignore 忽略的构建产物（pip install -e . 留下的 egg-info / __pycache__）——这些是 R4/R7 装依赖的必要结果 ; §9.1 的「跑后 porcelain 为空」按**未跟踪且未被忽略的文件**判定：施加补丁造成的已跟踪文件修改不算垃圾（补丁本身是判据的一部分）；基线检出时仍要求完全为空
